description: This file defines the class EmailTemplateFormBase, which provides functionalities to generate, display, process, and save email template forms within the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM derivative) system. It includes methods for rendering HTML forms, handling form submissions, processing attachments and images, and managing access control.

classes.name: EmailTemplateFormBase
classes.description: A class that provides methods for rendering email template forms, processing form submissions, handling attachments and images, and managing access control in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the form base class.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML form body for editing or creating an email template, including JavaScript validation and dynamic language support.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML form for creating or editing an email template, including headers, footers, and submit button.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the process of saving the email template form data, including populating the Bean from POST data, processing attachments, and performing access checks.

methods.name: handleAttachmentsProcessImages
methods.description: Processes images embedded in the email body, replaces image URLs with appropriate links, and saves the images as attachments.

methods.name: processImages
methods.description: Internal method to find, copy, and secure images embedded within the email body's HTML content.

methods.name: handleAttachments
methods.description: Handles the uploading and association of file attachments to the email template, including duplicates and document attachments.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for editing/saving email templates and restricts access accordingly.
